title: GoBench paper results: API and agentic-harness comparisons

sources.data: current reported Elo ratings and LLM comparisons
current precise LLM comparison values and run provenance

derivation.canonical_player_names: Runtime-specific aliases are normalized to the model names used by the paper.
derivation.rank: Section-specific confidence-interval-overlap ranks are copied from the current arena report.
derivation.katago_ratings: KataGo ratings and confidence intervals are refit from the current arena run's cumulative game provenance.
derivation.katago_seconds_per_move: sum(total_genmove_seconds) / sum(moves); estimated playout players multiply their base network timing by the playout count.
derivation.katago_temperature_timing: KataGo players ending in '-temp-X' use the measured seconds-per-move and derived cost of the otherwise identical player without the temperature suffix.
derivation.api_llm_selection: Completed API-only rows whose source player name ends with '-high-api'; the paper-facing name omits '-api'.
derivation.sol_harness_selection: Completed gpt5.6-sol API and Codex harness rows plotted in Figure 3; Prime isolated, Luna, single-turn Codex, and zero-game rows are excluded.
derivation.comparison_precision: Unrounded LLM numeric values come from the current run.json; displayed paper values are rounded in gobench2.tex.
derivation.game_records: Complete past games are collected from the current arena run provenance for exactly the union of datasets.llm_players and datasets.sol_harness_players.
derivation.game_player_normalization: Raw continual2 identifiers are preserved in source_llm_player and normalized to continual in llm_player, black, white, and winner.

games.inclusion_rule: Exactly the unique models represented in the current API and Sol harness figure/table datasets; no other LLM games are included.
games.moves_note: Each game's moves array contains the complete alternating board-move sequence for both players; result-row moves counts only LLM moves.

figure_2.caption: Elo versus cost per move for KataGo and API LLMs with reasoning effort set to high.

table_2.caption: API LLM evaluation results with reasoning effort set to high and KataGo reference players.
table_2.reference_note: The paper's 'KataGo (fastest)' row is the strongest b6c96 reference, not the minimum-time entry in the full dataset.
